decisionsTitle: «Ecusoane cu nume»: first names, a word and a colour per badge — the hotfixes of 2026-11-19 (amending §764)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, two days before Saturday's race (2026-11-21), forwarding the volunteers' coordinator:** «pune-mi și numele lor pe ele, să nu mai scriem cu carioca»; then «Vreau doar prenume pe ele»; «Vreau să pot customiza textele de pe fiecare ecuson în parte să pot scrie "Voluntar/Fotograf/Organizator" Dany/Amalia»; «Culoarea benzii, pe fiecare»; «Toate astea trebuie să fie configurabile». Shipped straight to production that morning as two hotfixes (pull requests #751 and #753; a third, the volunteers' Excel, #756, is below), their tests and this record after them. Amends §764's «No name is printed» and the badges page's «no volunteer is read».

**Decision.**

- **One box, «Ecusoane cu nume» / "Badges with names", below «Tipărire»** on «Ecusoane pentru voluntari» (`BadgeNamedPanel`): one line a badge — the word on its band, «;», the first name and, if wanted, «;» and the band's colour. It starts with one «WORD; First name» line per confirmed volunteer of the event, by name: the design's word for the band (the platform's «VOLUNTAR», or the club's own), and the first word of the name (`badgeFirstName`, the elite bib's rule) — their names alone, never a volunteer still «Înscris», a cancelled one or another event's (`badges.ts#listConfirmedVolunteerNames`). With nobody confirmed it starts empty and says «Niciun voluntar confirmat încă: scrie liniile de mână.» Anything in it can be changed, added or deleted; the help line names the colours in the page's language. A plain form, so it works with scripts off.
- **The list as it is read** (`badge-named.ts#parseNamedBadgeLines`): every line that is not blank is one badge, at most 300 (`NAMED_BADGES_MAX`, a pile of the per-role sheet's own bound); spaces are folded; a line without «;», or beginning with it, is a first name under the design's word; a word with no name prints the word alone; a name is cut at 40 characters by code points (`NAMED_BADGE_NAME_MAX`, an emoji never split) — a list that prints plainly beats one that is refused. The colour is a name in Romanian or in English, whatever its case and diacritics — portocaliu/orange (the club's orange, the band of a badge with no colour of its own), albastru/blue, verde/green, roșu/red, mov/violet/purple, turcoaz/teal, negru/black — or a `#rrggbb` code, written in lower case; any other word is no colour. Every named colour carries its words at AA (4.5 : 1): green is the deep green the site writes green words in (`COLOR.kindSpecialInk`), because the bibs' green reads at 4.4 : 1.
- **What prints** (`badges-pdf.ts`): the event's own design — its size, header, logo, title, telephone and cuts — on badges with no role: the line's word on the band in capitals, and the first name bold and in ink where «Nume:» and the marker's line would be, one line shrunk to the band's width and never cut; no «Nume:», no line for the name and no marker's area, since nothing is written by hand on these. The band wears the line's colour when it reads at AA (`badgeRoleColour`, checked again), the club's orange for a typed code that does not, and the design's own band — the one badge's colour, or the orange of the badges per role — for a line that named none. Each word is laid out on its own.
- **The first name and the watermark (§965).** With «Logo-ul clubului jos, ca filigran» the name stands where «Nume:» goes, above the logo — centred in the room between the writing area's top and the logo's top, at up to three quarters of it — so it does not sit on the logo, while the logo leaves a third of the writing area or more above it. When it leaves less — a size, space or move the club typed (§969) — the name keeps the writing area's middle at up to half its height, over the logo, as it does with the logo off. Measured since: the default lockup (67 %) leaves 27 % of the writing area above it — on 90 × 35, 100 × 40 and 90 × 60 mm alike — so at the default the name keeps the middle too; a smaller logo puts it above (20 % on the default strip leaves 39 %). Whether the default should stand above as well is the owner's to say.
- **Nothing is stored but a count.** The list is posted with the download (`POST /api/admin/events/<id>/badges/named`), so no name is ever in an address; the file is an attachment (`badges-names-<id8>-<locale>.pdf`) with `Cache-Control: private, no-store`; each download writes one audit row `event.badges_named_printed` on the event — who, which event and `{ badges: n }` — never a name, a word or a colour, as the other exports' rows (§322). The badges page now reads the confirmed volunteers' names, and nothing else of them.
- **Who.** Whoever designs the badges (`canDesignVolunteerBadges`: the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator), asserted on the server whatever the page drew (BR-REQ-060-01): the page is the 404 of an unknown page for every other role; the route answers 401 without a staff session, 403 to every other role before it reads the id, 404 for an id that is no uuid or an event that does not exist and 400 for a body that is not a form — none of them writing anything. The badges print in the language posted (Romanian for one that is not the site's).
- **The tests that came after the hotfixes:** the reading and the colours (`volunteers/badge-named.test.ts`), the drawing read from pdfkit's own calls (`volunteers/badge-named-pdf.test.ts`), the route on PGlite (`volunteers/badges-named-route.test.ts`) and the page (`volunteers/badges-named-page.test.ts`).

**Refused.** Saving the list: it is the paper of one print, and a stored list of names would be one more place that holds people. The surname by default: the owner's «doar prenume». A colour picker on every line: a word or a code typed beside the name is what the coordinator asked for, and the help line lists the words. Printing names on the badges per role, or reading anything of a volunteer but a confirmed one's name.

**The volunteers' Excel opens without «recover».** Every «Descarcă Excel» of the volunteers — an event's (§839) and «toate evenimentele» (§846) — opened in Excel with «We found a problem with some content … Do you want us to try to recover as much as we can?», whatever its data: write-excel-file 4.1.1 always writes an empty `<definedNames/>`, and §846's transform, finding no opening `<definedNames>`, added a second element after `</sheets>`, where a workbook holds one (`CT_Workbook`, ISO/IEC 29500). The filter's and the printed titles' names now go into the writer's own element, after the sheets and before `<calcPr>`, and both files are tested to hold exactly one (`volunteers/export-xlsx.test.ts`, `volunteers/export-all-xlsx.test.ts`). It amends nothing: a correction of §846's file, shipped as the hotfix #756.

**A branch's name says what is in it** — the owner, 2026-11-19, a standing rule: «ține minte de acum! numele branch-urilor trebuie să reflecte ce se află în ele». Every branch is named for what it carries — `feat/race-day-timing-raffle-results-presence`, `hotfix/volunteers-excel-one-defined-names` — and a branch that gathers several changes is named for all of them; never a generated name such as `claude/quirky-ramanujan-…`. A batch keeps its `batch/` prefix, which `yarn handoff` reads, and is named for what it gathers rather than for a date and a letter. A branch's `.release/` entry carries its name in the file's name and in its `branch` field, and renaming the branch changes neither, so the entry is written for the final name from the first commit, or renamed with the branch. A cloud session, which starts on a branch it did not name, renames it before its first push; where it may push only the branch it was given, it creates the named one with the GitHub tools only if they allow it, and otherwise pushes the given branch and asks the owner to rename it or to open the pull request from a named branch — never a way around what the session's environment allows. Written where branches are described, as AGENTS.md §1.4's row for the branch flow asks: CLAUDE.md § Working conventions, AGENTS.md §6.2, SETUP.md §1, § Contributing and §28, README.md § Branch and deployment flow, BUSINESS.md BR-BUS-090, MANIFEST.txt, `docs/DISPATCHER.md`, `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` § Coding from the phone and the standing rules of `docs/QUEUE.md`, which a session taking over reads first. The prefix of new behaviour is written `feat/`, as every branch of the repository spells it; the documents said `feature/`, which no branch used.
changelogLine: - **«Ecusoane cu nume» on the volunteers' badges, and a volunteers' Excel that opens cleanly** — below «Tipărire», one line a badge prints the word on its band, the first name and, if wanted, the band's colour, starting from the event's confirmed volunteers, the name standing above the club's logo watermark when the logo leaves it room; every «Descarcă Excel» of the volunteers opens in Excel without the offer to «recover» it. Both shipped as hotfixes on 2026-11-19; their tests follow, with the rule that a branch is named for what it carries. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Ecusoane pentru voluntari» for a role that designs the badges, then below «Tipărire» the box «Ecusoane cu nume» / "Badges with names" starts with one line per confirmed volunteer of the event, by name — the design's word for the band, «; » and the first word of the name — never a volunteer «Înscris», a cancelled one or another event's, and with nobody confirmed it is empty and says so; its plain form posts the list and the page's language to `POST /api/admin/events/<id>/badges/named`, so no name is ever in an address; every other role meets the page's 404 (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/badges-named-page.test.ts`.

Given a list posted to «Descarcă PDF cu nume», then every line that is not blank is one badge, at most 300 — the word on the band, «;», the first name and, if typed, «;» and the band's colour; a line without «;», or beginning with it, is a first name under the design's word, a word with no name prints alone, and a name is cut at 40 characters by code points, never refused; the colour is a name in Romanian or in English, whatever its case and diacritics — portocaliu/orange, albastru/blue, verde/green (the site's deep green: the bibs' reads under AA), roșu/red, mov/violet/purple, turcoaz/teal, negru/black, each readable at AA — or a `#rrggbb` code, and any other word is the design's band (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-named.test.ts`.

Given a badge of that list, when the sheet is drawn, then it has the event's design — its size, header, logo, title and telephone — and no role: the line's word on its band in capitals and the first name bold in ink where «Nume:» and the marker's line would be, one line shrunk to the band's width and never cut, with no «Nume:», no line for the name and no marker's area; its band is the line's colour when that reads at AA, the club's orange for a typed colour that does not, and the design's own band for a line that named none; with «Logo-ul clubului jos, ca filigran», while the logo leaves a third of the writing area or more above it, the name stands above the logo, centred in that room at up to three quarters of it, and otherwise — and with the logo off — in the writing area's middle at up to half its height (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-named-pdf.test.ts`.

Given `POST /api/admin/events/<id>/badges/named`, then a request without a staff session is answered 401, every role but the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator 403 before the id is read, an id that is no uuid or an event that does not exist 404, and a body that is not a form 400 — none of them writing anything; otherwise the answer is the PDF as an attachment `badges-names-<id8>-<locale>.pdf` with `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, in the language posted (Romanian for any other), and every download writes exactly one audit row `event.badges_named_printed` on the event whose metadata is `{ badges: n }` — never a name, a word or a colour (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/badges-named-route.test.ts`.

Given «Descarcă Excel» of an event's volunteers or «Descarcă Excel: toate evenimentele», when the workbook is written, then its `xl/workbook.xml` holds exactly one `<definedNames>` — the writer's own — carrying `_xlnm._FilterDatabase` and `_xlnm.Print_Titles`, after `</sheets>` and before `<calcPr>`, so Excel opens the file without offering to «recover» it (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/export-xlsx.test.ts`, `volunteers/export-all-xlsx.test.ts`.

batchLine: «Ecusoane cu nume» and the volunteers' Excel — the hotfixes' tests — and branches named for what they carry
